cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll arrange the handover, but I've told the committee I'm not chairing another year. That took six rehearsals in your car.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you stay until we find someone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the handover notes tonight. Don't ask me to undo the one rehearsal where I finally stopped apologising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that out. Tell them I said no without an excuse. You heard how hard that was.
